_doc: F7 P4 (Necron) block data from packet recordings. platforms: the blocks each side platform becomes at its removal ([x,y,z,state], consensus of the runs that removed it). columns: the lightning light columns, [minX, minZ, kind] (3x3, kind A y64-90, B y59-91). storms: per kind, one run's column frames [dt, y, s=sea_lantern|i=iron_block] (all 9 cells of the layer) and its 30 bolts, dt from the first bolt.
